content: {"like":["Values clear, well-defined character arcs and balanced storytelling; appreciates strong performances and thoughtful casting choices; enjoys creative, era‑capturing visuals and music; favors documentaries that expose systemic issues and provide thorough analysis; appreciates action films that blend escapism with realistic elements."],"dislike":["Dislikes over‑symbolic, chaotic, or disorganized filmmaking; rejects excessive rewrites, over‑directed scenes, and unnecessary visual gimmicks; finds poor dialogue and lack of emotional depth disappointing; dislikes unrealistic action sequences and weak character development; avoids films with excessive symbolic clutter or chaotic production choices."]}
